assumptions.successes: fixed 20 each hour, evenly spaced; total 480; not current probability throughput forecast
assumptions.reference: seven-quality advanced pond; bamboo rod, basic bait, group fit 1; well-mixed fish pool
assumptions.growth: T80 1/2/4/5/7/10/14d, 4cm birth, individual cap triangular(.85,1,1.15), length-uniform opening ages -14..0d
assumptions.refill: hour-end check <=40 fill 80, daily end fill 100 takes priority; current quality deficit weights relative to capacity 100
assumptions.omitted: spatial isolation, occupancy, migration, tackle failure, sleep, nutrition, explicit escapes and individual +/-10% bite/escape bias
